title: Fairness: who has received what
summary: A new Fairness tab on the Party page adds up the loot each party character has received, campaign to date or for one session.
items: Party → Fairness shows each character's coins, items at their recorded value and total, with how far they are ahead of or behind the party average.
Coin splits from a party fund or an encounter, encounter awards and treasure-pool items count. Purchases, trades, Give, wages, loans, payments and downtime don't.
Tap a character to see the receipts behind their total, newest session first.
Older encounter items that were awarded before values were recorded count as 0 cp and are marked, never guessed.
Everyone travelling with the party sees the party's totals; a player away from the party sees only their own.

When resolving the treasure pool, the DM can choose Favour whoever is behind: Need still comes before Greed, a tied top roll goes to whoever has received least, and round-robin hands items to whoever is furthest behind. The receipt shows the totals used.
New encounter awards now record each item's value on its ledger line, so it counts at the value the DM reviewed.
